Callout.Name: Visitor Search - Refusal
Callout.Message: Visitor refusing a search at the gate.
Callout.Advisory: One visitor, staff holding the queue.

Script.Line: I have been searched every visit for four years.
Today I am saying no and nobody has told me why.
The queue is not my problem.

Lines.Approach: They will not be searched and there are forty people in the queue behind them.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
